stages.action: Move to estimated pregrasp; jaws open
stages.entry: Fresh scene and selected candidate feasible

stages.action: Move to estimated candidate grasp pose
Close jaws under force-limited motor control
stages.control_exit: Fixed 0.75 s close; encoder feedback only

stages.entry: close action completed, not an oracle grasp gate
stages.evaluation: Source lifted >=0.09 m with donor contact

stages.action: Move upright source from A to the B work region
stages.evaluation: Source near prescribed B pose; no drop/collision

stages.action: Motorized Y rail approaches known B handle region; jaws open
stages.evaluation: No donor/receiver collision or nonfinger source contact

stages.action: Close synchronized upper/lower fingers on handle
stages.evaluation: At least one receiver finger contacts handle; both required after donor release

stages.entry: receiver close action completed, no truth-based gate
stages.evaluation: Receiver support maintained; donor release is intentional

stages.action: Withdraw 0.10 m along approach axis and raise 0.16 m
Raise Z rail by configured distance
Keep final motor targets for a fixed settling interval
stages.control_exit: Fixed settle_s; no oracle stability gate
stages.evaluation: Continue collision/drop sampling; no terminal stability score yet
Every step: recipient contact, donor detached, height, B pose, upright and speed limits

task_spec.policy: ID-only; same sequence/observation/limits for all selectors; no donor regrasp
task_spec.note: Stage evaluation never controls transitions. Thresholds come from config, not labels.

scope: initial width/IK/sampled approach only; not full-task feasibility or outcome
